answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 22300 Country: India Title: whether in jama masjid twice jamat can be offered for same waqt by different imam. 2.And my next question is that if offered in the varanda of the jama masjid the next jamat then what is your oponion. 3.I have two residence at a distance of 300 km then in which residance I have to offer qasar namaz . Question: 1.whether in jama masjid twice jamat can be offered for same waqt by different imam. 2.And my next question is that if offered in the varanda of the jama masjid the next jamat then what is your oponion. 3.I have two residence at a distance of 300 km then in which residance I have to offer qasar namaz . Answer ID: 22300 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 790/790/M=1431) (1) The second jamah in the portion of the mosque is makrooh . (2) If the veranda is included in the premises of the mosque then there too the second jamah would be makrooh . (3) The residence which is not your native place and you intend to stay there for 14 days or less, then you would offer qasr salah there. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
